[SWS_CM_10251] Value of the variant type field
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
The value of the type field shall be set to the value which is returned by the
ara::
core::Variant::index()
member function and incremented by 1.
Note:
The
ara::core::Variant::index()
member function returns a zero-based
index of the element hold in the Variant. A negative index represents a valueless
Variant.
⌋
